title: You're burning tokens and don't even know it #claudecode #ai #aiagents #claudeai
description:
Every side question you type in Claude Code permanently pollutes your context window. The /btw command fixes this — answers pop up in an overlay and vanish. Zero tokens wasted.

Full breakdown with live demos on the channel 👆

🧠 FREE community for AI builders → https://www.skool.com/nextphase-5790

#ClaudeCode #btw #AITokens #SaveMoney #AIProductivity #ContextWindow #Anthropic #Claude #Shorts #AITools #CodingTips #AIAutomation #NextPhase
transcript: Every time you ask Claude code a question mid-task, you're burning a lot of tokens without knowing about it. Here's what happens. You give Claude a task, it's working, and then you ask a side question. So now Claude is forced to stop and answer your question, and then it tries to resume. But that question and answer, they're now permanently in your context window. So any future message that you send to Claude, it rereads that side question. And obviously, this accumulates. So you probably waste like 30 to 40% of your context window on just noise. There is, however, one command that fixes this once and for all, and it's /btw, which stands for by the way. So you type /btw and then followed by your question. Claude gives you the answer in an overlay while the main Claude agent is still doing its work. Once that question is answered, it just completely vanishes and it never touches your context window. I've made a full live breakdown of how this feature works when you're working or building a project.
